title_my: မရပ်မနား လည်ပတ်နိုင်ရေး ကလင်နစ်
format: Executive diagnostic pop-up and appointment-led proof lab
commercial_tension: Operations leaders cannot quickly translate power interruptions into a decision-ready resilience brief.
tension_my: လုပ်ငန်းလည်ပတ်မှုအတွက် မီးအားပြတ်တောက်မှုကို ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်ချနိုင်တဲ့ resilience brief အဖြစ် မြန်မြန်ပြောင်းလဲဖို့ ခက်ခဲနေပါတယ်။
insight: When the conversation begins with the work that must not stop, a power solution becomes an operating choice rather than a hardware comparison.
insight_my: မရပ်တန့်သင့်တဲ့ အလုပ်ကနေ စတင်ပြောဆိုလိုက်တဲ့အခါ Power solution က hardware နှိုင်းယှဉ်မှုမဟုတ်ဘဲ လုပ်ငန်းလည်ပတ်ရေး ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်တစ်ခု ဖြစ်လာပါတယ်။
behaviour_change: Move from passive interest to a booked, client-authorised load and continuity assessment.
behaviour_my: စိတ်ဝင်စားရုံမှ လက်ရှိ load နှင့် continuity assessment ကို client approval ဖြင့် booking လုပ်သည့် အဆင့်သို့ ရွှေ့ပြောင်းစေပါမည်။
conversion: A 12-minute 'critical-load card' produces a named assessment booking and consented follow-up.
conversion_my: ၁၂ မိနစ် Critical-load card က အမည်တပ် assessment booking နှင့် ခွင့်ပြုထားသော follow-up ကို ဖြစ်ပေါ်စေပါမည်။
tagline: Power the work that cannot pause.
tagline_my: မရပ်တန့်သင့်တဲ့ အလုပ်အတွက် မီးအားကို အဆင်သင့်ထားပါ။
seasonal: Proposed for September 2026 as a pre-Q4 continuity-planning clinic; date and venue TBC.
seasonal_my: Q4 မတိုင်မီ continuity planning အတွက် ၂၀၂၆ စက်တင်ဘာလတွင် အဆိုပြုထားခြင်းဖြစ်ပြီး ရက်စွဲနှင့် venue ကို TBC ထားပါမည်။
message: Start with the load that protects your customer promise.
message_my: သင့် customer promise ကို ကာကွယ်ပေးမယ့် load ကနေ စတင်ပါ။
cta_my: Critical-load assessment ကို booking လုပ်ပါ။
plan: Invite 40 named operations, finance and facility decision-makers through client-approved lists.
Run a guided diagnostic sequence: interruption map, critical-load card and engineering handoff.
Issue a one-page 'next decision' recap within 48 hours after consented follow-up.
content_system: One operating-continuity hero film, five 15-second job-to-be-done cutdowns, a diagnostic-card carousel and a post-clinic recap template.
talent_logic: A credible Myanmar-speaking facilitator and a technical spokesperson; both proposed/TBC, with suitability, usage and safety clearance required.
production: Indoor 8m x 6m proof lab, four consultation stations, low-noise display power, QR registration, bilingual moderator cards, accessibility seating and engineered power distribution.
budget_structure: Consultation-led: spend prioritises facilitation, data-capture workflow and compact proof modules over crowd scale.
video_premise: A single interruption threatens a customer promise; the protagonist isolates the work that must continue and takes a clear next step.
story_location: Proposed/TBC Yangon office, workshop or clinic environment
visual_style: warm industrial realism with precise cobalt information light

title_my: မီးအားအဖြေကို လက်တွေ့ပြသတဲ့ Roadshow
commercial_tension: Commercial buyers see technical options but lack a comparable route from current energy use to a scoped solution.
tension_my: Commercial buyer များက technical option များကို မြင်နေရပေမယ့် လက်ရှိ energy use ကနေ scoped solution သို့ သွားမယ့် နှိုင်းယှဉ်နိုင်သော လမ်းကြောင်း မရှင်းလင်းပါ။
insight: A live before-and-after load story makes an abstract system feel operationally legible.
insight_my: Live before-and-after load story တစ်ခုက မမြင်ရသေးတဲ့ system ကို လုပ်ငန်းအသုံးချနိုင်တဲ့ အဖြေအဖြစ် နားလည်လွယ်စေပါတယ်။
behaviour_change: Move from brochure collection to a client-approved site-survey request.
behaviour_my: Brochure စုဆောင်းရုံမှ client-approved site-survey request တင်သည့် အဆင့်သို့ ရွှေ့ပြောင်းစေပါမည်။
conversion: A 'bill-to-blueprint' station turns a volunteered consumption range into a survey request, subject to consent and engineering validation.
conversion_my: Bill-to-blueprint station မှာ ပေးအပ်ထားတဲ့ consumption range ကို consent နှင့် engineering validation အောက်တွင် survey request အဖြစ် ပြောင်းလဲပေးပါမည်။
territory: See the System, See the Decision
tagline: From power questions to a practical next move.
tagline_my: မီးအားမေးခွန်းကနေ လက်တွေ့လုပ်ဆောင်ချက်အထိ။
seasonal: Proposed October 2026 business-continuity route, scheduled away from the 25–27 October Thadingyut public holidays; route/venue/permits TBC.
seasonal_my: Thadingyut holiday (အောက်တိုဘာ ၂၅–၂၇) ကို ရှောင်ရှားပြီး ၂၀၂၆ အောက်တိုဘာ business-continuity route အဖြစ် အဆိုပြုထားခြင်းဖြစ်ကာ route၊ venue နှင့် permit များကို TBC ထားပါမည်။
message: Bring the load profile; leave with the next decision.
message_my: သင့် load profile ကို ယူလာပါ၊ နောက်တစ်ဆင့် ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်နဲ့ ပြန်သွားပါ။
cta_my: Site survey ကို တောင်းဆိုပါ။
plan: Deploy a modular truck-or-tent demonstration to two or three client-approved commercial clusters.
Demonstrate an interruption-to-storage-to-critical-load sequence on safe display equipment only.
Capture qualified survey requests via consented QR flow and route each to a named client sales owner.
content_system: A route announcement film, two live-demo explainers, city-specific invitation cards, engineering FAQ clips and a post-stop survey-request sequence.
talent_logic: A field presenter plus client-approved technical demonstrator; no installer or partner is named until contracted.
production: Approx. 10m x 8m modular canopy or vehicle footprint, compliant temporary electrical distribution, shade, queue rails, bilingual wayfinding, survey counter and weather plan.
budget_structure: Route-led: spend changes primarily with stop count, transport, temporary engineering, crew travel and local permissions.
video_premise: A manager watches a workflow pause, then sees the same task continue through a transparent live demonstration.
story_location: Proposed/TBC commercial cluster and controlled demonstration bay
visual_style: sunlit documentary energy with graphic signal lines

title_my: ညပိုင်းအလုပ် မရပ်တန့်စေရ
format: Micro-business product launch and after-dark retail activation
commercial_tension: Small operators fear a solution will be complicated, expensive or disruptive to install.
tension_my: အသေးစားလုပ်ငန်းရှင်များက solution တစ်ခုဟာ ရှုပ်ထွေးမယ်၊ ကုန်ကျစရိတ်ကြီးမယ်၊ installation က လုပ်ငန်းကို အနှောင့်အယှက်ဖြစ်မယ်လို့ စိုးရိမ်ကြပါတယ်။
insight: A visible night-time proof moment helps owners judge continuity in the terms that matter: light, payment, refrigeration and service.
insight_my: ညပိုင်းမှာ မြင်ရတဲ့ proof moment က light, payment, refrigeration နဲ့ service တို့လို ပိုင်ရှင်အတွက် အရေးကြီးတဲ့ အချက်များနဲ့ continuity ကို တိုင်းတာစေပါတယ်။
behaviour_change: Move from uncertainty to a verified product-demo appointment and affordability conversation.
behaviour_my: မသေချာမှုမှ verified product-demo appointment နှင့် affordability conversation သို့ ရွှေ့ပြောင်းစေပါမည်။
conversion: A four-task night-shift demo unlocks a QR appointment slot; no saving, output or availability claim is made at the activation.
conversion_my: Task လေးမျိုးပါဝင်တဲ့ night-shift demo က QR appointment slot ကို ဖွင့်ပေးမည်ဖြစ်ပြီး activation အတွင်း saving၊ output သို့မဟုတ် availability claim မပြုလုပ်ပါ။
tagline: When the day keeps going, your work can too.
tagline_my: နေ့ရက်ဆက်သွားနေသလို သင့်အလုပ်လည်း ဆက်လက်လည်ပတ်နိုင်ပါစေ။
seasonal: Proposed for early November 2026, before the 23–24 November Tazaungdaing public holidays; client-approved retail venue and operating hours TBC.
seasonal_my: Tazaungdaing holiday (နိုဝင်ဘာ ၂၃–၂၄) မတိုင်မီ ၂၀၂၆ နိုဝင်ဘာအစောပိုင်းတွင် အဆိုပြုထားပြီး client-approved retail venue နှင့် operating hours ကို TBC ထားပါမည်။
message: Choose the work you cannot afford to pause.
message_my: မရပ်တန့်စေချင်တဲ့ သင့်အလုပ်ကို ရွေးချယ်ပါ။
cta_my: Live demo အတွက် နေရာကြိုတင်ယူပါ။
plan: Build a dusk-to-night demonstration bay with four micro-business task zones.
Use a host-led sequence to show safe, labelled demonstration loads only.
Provide appointment booking, customer-consent capture and a next-day bilingual follow-up message.
content_system: A 30-second 'four tasks' film, store-owner portrait reels, appointment reminders and a simple myth-versus-question card series.
talent_logic: Real-owner casting is optional and proposed/TBC; use actors unless written permissions, releases and claims substantiation are secured.
production: Approx. 7m x 7m darkened demo bay, controlled light levels, mock point-of-sale and refrigeration props, safe low-load practicals, queue handling and security review.
budget_structure: Demo-module-led: spend prioritises safe task-zone fabrication, controlled lighting and customer appointment operations.
video_premise: At dusk, four ordinary work moments face a pause; a practical, human answer keeps each one moving.
visual_style: intimate dusk cinematography, amber practicals and clean white task light

title_en: Solar Open House: The Installation You Can Inspect
title_my: ကိုယ်တိုင်ကြည့်ရှုစစ်ဆေးနိုင်တဲ့ Solar Open House
format: Invitation-only executive site walk and press-preview format
commercial_tension: Decision-makers want proof of installation quality and after-sales thinking, not only product claims.
tension_my: ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်ချသူများက product claim တင်မကဘဲ installation quality နှင့် after-sales thinking ကို ကိုယ်တိုင်မြင်ချင်ကြပါတယ်။
insight: Trust grows when a complex system is explained through the questions a buyer would naturally ask on site.
insight_my: Buyer တစ်ယောက် site ပေါ်မှာ မေးမယ့် သဘာဝမေးခွန်းများနဲ့ complex system ကို ရှင်းပြတဲ့အခါ ယုံကြည်မှု ပိုတက်လာပါတယ်။
behaviour_change: Move from generic interest to a governed tender or engineering-scoping conversation.
behaviour_my: သာမန်စိတ်ဝင်စားမှုမှ စနစ်တကျထိန်းချုပ်ထားသော tender သို့မဟုတ် engineering-scoping conversation သို့ ရွှေ့ပြောင်းစေပါမည်။
conversion: A signed visitor checklist and a 'questions for your site' card prompt a follow-up technical briefing.
conversion_my: Visitor checklist နှင့် Questions for your site card က follow-up technical briefing ကို ဖြစ်ပေါ်စေပါမည်။
tagline: Inspect the details behind dependable power.
tagline_my: စိတ်ချရတဲ့ မီးအားနောက်က detail များကို ကိုယ်တိုင်ကြည့်ရှုပါ။
seasonal: Proposed for late November 2026 after the listed Tazaungdaing holidays, subject to client site, safety, stakeholder and permission approvals.
seasonal_my: Tazaungdaing holiday ပြီးနောက် ၂၀၂၆ နိုဝင်ဘာနှောင်းပိုင်းတွင် အဆိုပြုထားပြီး client site၊ safety၊ stakeholder နှင့် permission approval များ လိုအပ်ပါမည်။
message: Ask the questions that make the next decision safer.
cta_my: Technical briefing ကို တောင်းဆိုပါ။
plan: Secure one client-approved operational site or build an equivalent controlled mock-up if a live site is unavailable.
Guide small groups through six inspection stations: design, safety, monitoring, handover, maintenance and escalation.
Run a media/industry preview only after claims, access, participant releases and site permissions are cleared.
content_system: An inspection-guide film, six detail explainers, a buyer question checklist and an executive recap article.
talent_logic: Technical host, client spokesperson and optional media facilitator are proposed/TBC; all onsite roles require safety induction and release control.
production: Live site or engineered mock-up; controlled visitor routes, high-visibility PPE where required, sound-managed briefing point, hazard assessment, security and rain fallback.
budget_structure: Assurance-led: spend scales with controlled access, safety, documentation, technical staging and small-group hospitality rather than audience volume.
video_premise: A buyer's unanswered questions become a calm site-walk narrative where each detail has a visible reason.
story_location: Client-approved active site or engineered mock-up, proposed/TBC
visual_style: premium daylight precision, quiet authority and documentary macro detail

commercial_tension: A growing category requires buyers to understand the quality of handover and service, while practitioners need a consistent customer-explanation standard.
tension_my: ကြီးထွားလာတဲ့ category မှာ buyer များက handover နဲ့ service quality ကို နားလည်ဖို့လိုပြီး practitioner များကလည်း customer ကို ရှင်းပြတဲ့ စံနှုန်းတစ်ခု လိုအပ်ပါတယ်။
insight: The strongest product story is often told through a capable practitioner who can explain what happens after installation.
insight_my: အကောင်းဆုံး product story က installation ပြီးနောက် ဘာဖြစ်မလဲကို ရှင်းပြနိုင်တဲ့ practitioner တစ်ယောက်ကနေ ထွက်ပေါ်တတ်ပါတယ်။
behaviour_change: Move from ad-hoc selling to a client-approved learning pathway and consented lead-routing standard.
behaviour_my: အလိုအလျောက်ရောင်းချမှုမှ client-approved learning pathway နှင့် consented lead-routing standard သို့ ရွှေ့ပြောင်းစေပါမည်။
conversion: A practical knowledge check and service-script rehearsal qualify attendees for a next-step accreditation conversation, not a public credential claim.
conversion_my: Practical knowledge check နှင့် service-script rehearsal က public credential claim မဟုတ်ဘဲ next-step accreditation conversation အတွက် attendee များကို qualify လုပ်ပေးပါမည်။
tagline: A better handover starts before the install.
tagline_my: ပိုကောင်းတဲ့ handover က installation မတိုင်မီကပဲ စတင်ပါတယ်။
seasonal: Proposed for the first half of December 2026 as a year-end capability reset; programme partner, venue and accreditation status TBC.
seasonal_my: Year-end capability reset အဖြစ် ၂၀၂၆ ဒီဇင်ဘာအစောပိုင်းတွင် အဆိုပြုထားပြီး programme partner၊ venue နှင့် accreditation status ကို TBC ထားပါမည်။
message: Teach the customer what happens next—and why it matters.
message_my: နောက်တစ်ဆင့်မှာ ဘာဖြစ်မလဲ၊ ဘာကြောင့်အရေးကြီးလဲကို customer ကို ရှင်းပြပါ။
cta: Apply for the next learning cohort.
cta_my: နောက်ထပ် learning cohort အတွက် လျှောက်ထားပါ။
plan: Host a small-cohort masterclass built around safe handover, service dialogue and consented lead escalation.
Use a mock customer briefing, troubleshooting decision tree and observed practical assessment.
Issue participation records only after client legal and training approvals; do not imply external certification.
content_system: Three learning capsules, a facilitator film, downloadable service-language cards and a post-session knowledge-recall sequence.
talent_logic: Facilitator, technical assessor and participant talent are proposed/TBC; all competence claims require client review and source evidence.
production: Approx. 9m x 7m classroom/lab, demonstration bench, workshop tools only if supplier-engineered, camera capture for replay, quiet audio and accessible seating.
budget_structure: Capability-led: spend focuses on curriculum, facilitation, participant operations, assessment design and reusable training capture.
video_premise: A practitioner reframes a technical answer into a human promise, then sees a customer understand what comes next.
visual_style: clear, optimistic workshop craft with emerald learning cues

title_my: လမ်းကြောင်းတိုင်းကို အားဖြည့်မည့် Charge the Route
commercial_tension: Fleet and dealer leaders may treat electrification and energy resilience as separate decisions.
tension_my: Fleet နှင့် dealer leader များက electrification နဲ့ energy resilience ကို သီးခြားဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်အဖြစ် မြင်နိုင်ပါတယ်။
insight: When route reliability, charging and site energy are shown as one operating system, the conversation becomes commercial rather than speculative.
insight_my: Route reliability, charging နဲ့ site energy ကို operating system တစ်ခုတည်းအဖြစ် ပြသတဲ့အခါ ဆွေးနွေးမှုက စိတ်ကူးယဉ်မဟုတ်ဘဲ commercial အဖြေ ဖြစ်လာပါတယ်။
behaviour_change: Move from generic EV curiosity to a booked fleet-readiness workshop.
behaviour_my: သာမန် EV စိတ်ဝင်စားမှုမှ booked fleet-readiness workshop သို့ ရွှေ့ပြောင်းစေပါမည်။
conversion: A route-board session captures operational variables and books a client-reviewed feasibility conversation.
conversion_my: Route-board session က operational variable များကို စုဆောင်းပြီး client-reviewed feasibility conversation ကို booking လုပ်ပေးပါမည်။
tagline: Plan the route. Power the next move.
tagline_my: လမ်းကြောင်းကို စီမံပါ။ နောက်တစ်ဆင့်ကို အားဖြည့်ပါ။
seasonal: Proposed for September–October 2026 business-planning season; venue, vehicle access, charger hardware and permissions TBC.
seasonal_my: Business-planning season အဖြစ် ၂၀၂၆ စက်တင်ဘာ–အောက်တိုဘာတွင် အဆိုပြုထားပြီး venue၊ vehicle access၊ charger hardware နှင့် permission များကို TBC ထားပါမည်။
message: Your route is an energy decision too.
message_my: သင့်လမ်းကြောင်းကလည်း energy decision တစ်ခုပါပဲ။
cta_my: Fleet-readiness workshop ကို booking လုပ်ပါ။
plan: Build a moderated route-board forum for fleet, site, finance and operations roles.
Use non-live or supplier-approved charging hardware demonstrations; no vehicle performance claim without substantiation.
Route all feasibility requests through consented booking and client-approved qualification.
content_system: A route-planning hero film, three executive explainers, fleet-checklist content and a workshop invitation sequence.
talent_logic: A mobility moderator and technical guide are proposed/TBC; any vehicle or charging brand involvement requires separate written permission.
production: Approx. 12m x 10m dealer/forum footprint, static vehicle display only if cleared, safe cordoning, visibility zones, route-board wall, seating and technical power plan.
budget_structure: Mobility-forum-led: spend varies by vehicle/hardware access, safety marshals, executive hospitality and interactive route-board technology.
video_premise: A route manager pins urgent stops to a board and realises every kilometre depends on a site-level power decision.
story_location: Proposed/TBC dealer forecourt or fleet depot
visual_style: crisp kinetic mobility language with lime signal accents

title_my: အရေးကြီးသည့်အရာများအတွက် အလင်းရောင်
format: Community listening programme and proposed/TBC social-impact activation
commercial_tension: Community-energy conversations can become performative if local priorities, safeguards and selection criteria are not visible.
tension_my: Local priority၊ safeguard နဲ့ selection criteria များ မရှင်းလင်းလျှင် community-energy conversation က အပြသသက်သက် ဖြစ်သွားနိုင်ပါတယ်။
insight: Respect is communicated through listening, transparent criteria and a clear boundary between a public conversation and a promised delivery.
insight_my: နားထောင်ပေးခြင်း၊ transparent criteria နှင့် public conversation နဲ့ promised delivery ကြားက နယ်နိမိတ်ကို ရှင်းပြခြင်းက လေးစားမှုကို ပြသပါတယ်။
behaviour_change: Move from passive awareness to consented participation in an evidence-led community needs conversation.
behaviour_my: စိတ်ဝင်စားရုံမှ evidence-led community needs conversation တွင် consent ဖြင့် ပါဝင်သည့်အဆင့်သို့ ရွှေ့ပြောင်းစေပါမည်။
conversion: A facilitated needs wall and opt-in feedback card generate a transparent, non-binding shortlisting brief.
conversion_my: Facilitated needs wall နှင့် opt-in feedback card က transparent ဖြစ်တဲ့ non-binding shortlisting brief ကို ဖန်တီးပေးပါမည်။
tagline: Start with what a community says it needs.
tagline_my: Community က လိုအပ်တယ်လို့ ပြောတဲ့အရာကနေ စတင်ပါ။
seasonal: Proposed for December 2026 community reflection period; partner, location, participation safeguards and any delivery commitment TBC.
seasonal_my: Community reflection period အဖြစ် ၂၀၂၆ ဒီဇင်ဘာတွင် အဆိုပြုထားပြီး partner၊ location၊ participation safeguard နှင့် delivery commitment များကို TBC ထားပါမည်။
message: A responsible energy conversation begins by listening.
message_my: တာဝန်ရှိတဲ့ energy conversation က နားထောင်ခြင်းနဲ့ စတင်ပါတယ်။
cta: Share a priority through the approved participation channel.
cta_my: Approved participation channel မှတစ်ဆင့် သင့်ဦးစားပေးကို မျှဝေပါ။
plan: Co-design a listening session only with client-approved local partner and safeguarding protocol.
Use anonymised, consented feedback mechanisms and publish the selection method before any potential support is announced.
Create a community report-back that states what is heard, what is proposed/TBC and what cannot be promised.
content_system: A listening-principles film, participant-consent explainer, transparent criteria cards and a report-back template.
talent_logic: Facilitator and community participants are proposed/TBC; translation, safeguarding, consent and no-testimonial coercion are mandatory.
production: Approx. 8m x 8m accessible listening circle, low-stimulus sound plan, child-safeguarding boundaries where applicable, privacy-first feedback station and weather contingency.
budget_structure: Safeguarding-led: spend is reserved for facilitation, accessibility, consent, translation, local logistics and transparent report-back—not unverified giving claims.
video_premise: Rather than arriving with an answer, a facilitator asks one quiet question and lets community voices define the frame.
visual_style: human-centred natural light, restrained documentary intimacy and honest texture

title_my: ကျွန်တော့် Load၊ ကျွန်တော့် Plan
format: Paid digital funnel and interactive decision UI
commercial_tension: Prospects can research equipment but struggle to know what information is needed before a meaningful conversation.
tension_my: Prospect များက equipment ကို လေ့လာနိုင်ပေမယ့် အဓိပ္ပာယ်ရှိတဲ့ conversation မတိုင်မီ ဘာအချက်အလက်လိုအပ်လဲဆိုတာ ခက်ခဲနေပါတယ်။
insight: A simple guided estimate is more useful when it helps a person prepare the right question, rather than pretending to deliver an engineering answer.
insight_my: Engineering answer ပေးသလို မလုပ်ဘဲ မှန်ကန်တဲ့မေးခွန်းကို ပြင်ဆင်မေးနိုင်အောင် ကူညီပေးတဲ့ guided estimate က ပိုအသုံးဝင်ပါတယ်။
behaviour_change: Move from unqualified clicks to a consented, information-ready assessment booking.
behaviour_my: Qualification မရှိတဲ့ click များမှ consent ပါသော၊ information-ready assessment booking သို့ ရွှေ့ပြောင်းစေပါမည်။
conversion: A five-step calculator captures the user's priority, not an installation promise, then routes to a reviewed booking flow.
conversion_my: Step ငါးခုပါ calculator က installation promise မဟုတ်ဘဲ user priority ကို စုဆောင်းပြီး reviewed booking flow သို့ ချိတ်ဆက်ပေးပါမည်။
tagline: Tell us what must keep running.
tagline_my: သင့်အတွက် မရပ်တန့်သင့်တဲ့အရာကို ပြောပြပါ။
seasonal: Proposed for December 2026 budget-planning and re-engagement windows; media inventory, data policy and destination experience TBC.
seasonal_my: Budget-planning နှင့် re-engagement window အဖြစ် ၂၀၂၆ ဒီဇင်ဘာတွင် အဆိုပြုထားပြီး media inventory၊ data policy နှင့် destination experience ကို TBC ထားပါမည်။
message: The right first question is not 'which panel?' but 'what must run?'.
message_my: ပထမမေးခွန်းက which panel? မဟုတ်ပါ—what must run? ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။
cta_my: Discussion brief ကို စတင်တည်ဆောက်ပါ။
plan: Drive paid traffic to a bilingual five-step experience: context, priority, interruption pattern, decision horizon and consented contact.
Return a 'discussion brief' labelled as preliminary, non-engineering and subject to survey.
Use conversion API and CRM events only after legal/privacy approval and appropriate user notice.
content_system: Six outcome-led ad variants, a decision-journey film, interactive UI microcopy, retargeting FAQs and consent-led reminder messages.
talent_logic: No external talent required; optional narrator proposed/TBC with Myanmar language review and usage clearance.
production: Responsive UI storyboard, accessible contrast, mobile-first flows, analytic-event map, consent management, localisation QA and secure client-approved hosting.
budget_structure: Performance-led: spend flexes between media, UX, analytics instrumentation, localisation and CRM rather than physical fabrication.
video_premise: A busy owner is asked the wrong question, then a better one unlocks a clear conversation path on a phone.
story_location: Bilingual mobile UI and everyday business settings
visual_style: calm interface-led realism with crisp white and solar-yellow signals

format: Proof-led content series and monitored social challenge
commercial_tension: Performance claims can blur together when buyers cannot see how a solution is evaluated in normal working conditions.
tension_my: သာမန်လုပ်ငန်းအခြေအနေမှာ solution တစ်ခုကို ဘယ်လိုစစ်ဆေးသလဲ မမြင်နိုင်တဲ့အခါ performance claim တွေက တစ်ပုံစံတည်း ဖြစ်သွားနိုင်ပါတယ်။
insight: A transparent question is more credible than a grand promise: what do we need to observe, document and verify before a buyer decides?
insight_my: ကြီးမားတဲ့ promise ထက် transparent question က ပိုယုံကြည်ရပါတယ်—buyer ဆုံးဖြတ်မတိုင်မီ ဘာကို observe, document နဲ့ verify လုပ်ရမလဲ?
behaviour_change: Move from passive video viewing to a consented request for a verification-oriented consultation.
behaviour_my: Video ကိုကြည့်ရုံမှ verification-oriented consultation တောင်းဆိုမှုသို့ ရွှေ့ပြောင်းစေပါမည်။
conversion: Each episode ends with a question checklist and a voluntary booking prompt, never a public endurance or performance guarantee.
conversion_my: Episode တစ်ခုစီရဲ့အဆုံးမှာ question checklist နှင့် voluntary booking prompt ပါဝင်ပြီး public endurance သို့မဟုတ် performance guarantee မပြုလုပ်ပါ။
tagline: Good decisions deserve a better question.
tagline_my: ကောင်းတဲ့ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်အတွက် ပိုကောင်းတဲ့မေးခွန်း လိုအပ်ပါတယ်။
seasonal: Proposed for late November through December 2026 as a Q4 proof-and-planning content series; challenge mechanic and claims review TBC.
seasonal_my: Q4 proof-and-planning content series အဖြစ် ၂၀၂၆ နိုဝင်ဘာနှောင်းပိုင်းမှ ဒီဇင်ဘာအထိ အဆိုပြုထားပြီး challenge mechanic နှင့် claims review ကို TBC ထားပါမည်။
message: Do not accept a promise you cannot interrogate.
message_my: မေးခွန်းမေး၍ မရတဲ့ promise ကို အလွယ်တကူ မလက်ခံပါနဲ့။
cta_my: Buyer question checklist ကို တောင်းဆိုပါ။
plan: Produce a six-episode editorial series following questions, not claimed results.
Run a monitored social prompt inviting users to share their own question, with moderation and participation terms before launch.
Route high-intent requests to a client-approved consultation flow with a record of consent.
content_system: Six 45-second editorial films, 12 vertical cutdowns, question cards, a buyer checklist and a moderation playbook.
talent_logic: Use an independent presenter and technical reviewer only after claims, qualifications, script and usage approvals; both proposed/TBC.
production: Small controlled studio plus approved technical set, precision macro camera package, product placeholders until supplied, subtitles, accessibility copy and moderation desk.
budget_structure: Editorial-led: spend scales with episode count, subject-matter review, studio controls, post-production versioning and moderation capacity.
video_premise: A series of beautiful product claims dissolves into one grounded question: 'How would you verify that?'
story_location: Proposed/TBC studio and controlled technical demonstration set
visual_style: high-contrast editorial craft, macro detail and measured kinetic typography

title_my: ပြန်လည်စတင်ဖို့ Renewal Window
format: CRM reactivation and account-based decision-sprint programme
commercial_tension: Qualified conversations can stall when a buyer's internal timeline changes, even though the underlying need remains.
tension_my: Buyer ရဲ့ internal timeline ပြောင်းသွားတဲ့အခါ underlying need ရှိနေသော်လည်း qualified conversation များ ရပ်တန့်သွားနိုင်ပါတယ်။
insight: Reactivation works best when it offers a useful new decision moment rather than repeating the original sales message.
insight_my: Reactivation က မူလ sales message ကို ထပ်ခါပြောခြင်းထက် အသုံးဝင်တဲ့ decision moment အသစ်တစ်ခု ပေးတဲ့အခါ ပိုအလုပ်ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။
behaviour_change: Move from dormant lead status to an explicit close, defer or re-scope decision.
behaviour_my: Dormant lead status မှ explicit close, defer သို့မဟုတ် re-scope decision အဆင့်သို့ ရွှေ့ပြောင်းစေပါမည်။
conversion: A three-message 'renewal window' offers a one-click priority choice and a booked decision sprint only to consented contacts.
conversion_my: Message သုံးခုပါ Renewal Window က one-click priority choice နှင့် consent ပေးထားတဲ့ contact များအတွက်သာ booked decision sprint ကို ပေးပါမည်။
territory: The Next Decision Is Still Yours
tagline: Reopen the question on your terms.
tagline_my: သင့်စည်းကမ်းနဲ့ မေးခွန်းကို ပြန်ဖွင့်ပါ။
seasonal: Proposed for December 2026, avoiding 4 December National Day and 25 December Christmas Day communication dates unless the client confirms operational suitability.
seasonal_my: National Day (ဒီဇင်ဘာ ၄) နှင့် Christmas Day (ဒီဇင်ဘာ ၂၅) ဆက်သွယ်ရေးရက်များကို client operational suitability အတည်ပြုမှသာ အသုံးပြုမည်ဖြစ်ပြီး ၂၀၂၆ ဒီဇင်ဘာအတွက် အဆိုပြုထားပါသည်။
message: Choose the decision that helps your team move forward.
message_my: သင့် team ကို ရှေ့ဆက်စေမယ့် decision ကို ရွေးချယ်ပါ။
cta: Choose: revisit, re-scope or close for now.
cta_my: ပြန်လည်ဆွေးနွေးမည်၊ re-scope လုပ်မည် သို့မဟုတ် ယာယီပိတ်မည်—ရွေးချယ်ပါ။
plan: Segment only client-approved, lawfully contacted CRM records with suppression and consent rules applied.
Deliver three value-led messages: updated question, decision brief and optional 20-minute sprint.
Measure response, booked sprint, re-qualified opportunity and explicit opt-out; do not infer personal intent.
content_system: Three CRM messages, account-specific decision-brief template, an executive motion film and sales-owner follow-up scripts.
talent_logic: No external talent needed; optional voice artist proposed/TBC for film, subject to language and usage approval.
production: CRM workflow map, approved data segmentation, bilingual email/landing templates, analytics tags, opt-out controls and accessibility-tested motion assets.
budget_structure: Precision-CRM-led: spend concentrates on segmentation, content personalisation, workflow governance, sales enablement and measurement rather than reach media.
video_premise: A paused email thread becomes a calm choice architecture that gives the buyer agency to reopen, re-scope or pause.
visual_style: quiet executive clarity, warm paper textures and decisive motion graphics
